gizmo.title: Viidiyoo
gizmo.description: Taphachiisa viidiyoo dhaqqabamaa madda hedduu irraa.

advanced.title: Sararoota barreeffamaa
advanced.description: Mata-duree cufaa, hiika jalaa, ibsaa fi sararoota barreeffamaa biroo viidiyoof.

advanced.title: Yeroo xumuraa
advanced.description: Viidiyoo yeroo murtaa'e (sekondii) irratti xumuri, yeroo jalqabaa barbaada.

advanced.title: Haalata barumsaa dandeessisi
advanced.description: Dafanii fuuldura deemuu fi duubatti deebi'uu dhorka.

advanced.title: Qabduu YouTube irratti banuu balleessi
advanced.description: Qabduu viidiyoo YouTube irratti banuu balleessa.

advanced.title: Mallattoo yeroo dhoksi
advanced.description: Barreeffama dubbii irratti mallattoo yeroo dhoksi.

advanced.title: Sarara ibsa sagaleen
advanced.description: URL sarara ibsa sagaleen (faayilii MP3) kan wantoota mul'atan ibsu.

developer.title: Taphachiisa duubaa hayyami
developer.description: Yeroo taabiin biraawuzaraa xiyyeeffannaa dhabu taphachuu itti fufi.

developer.title: Walqunnamtii Dhorki
developer.description: Haalata walqunnamtii barreeffama dubbii cuqaasamaa taasisu dhorki.
